messages:
Leah: hey team, meet Bailey 🦎 — just brought home my bearded dragon and he insisted on climbing onto my laptop for a victory nap. uploaded an image: Bailey_keyboard.jpg
Nate: wait, is that a tiny reptile standup meeting? :laughing: looks like Bailey has better posture than me
Priya: omg adorable. does he like basking on warm keyboards or is that a one-off?
Leah: apparently he loves the warmth. vet said short supervised sessions only. no water bowl on the desk tho :sweat_smile:
Sam: honest question — is Bailey allowed in the office if we do a pet day? (I promise to bring disinfectant)
Ivy: @Sam maybe a low-key visit? ops-bot, are there any pet-day rules again?
ops-bot: Reminder: office pet visits must be pre-approved by People Ops, proof of vaccinations/health check for mammals only. Reptiles require prior sign-off and a contained carrier during transit.
Leah: thanks @ops-bot — totally respected. was just daydreaming about a Bailey cameo in the kitchen.
Nate: that photo is a whole mood. caption contest? mine: "standup complete, backlog conquered" :trophy:
Priya: caption: "Low-latency cuddles, high-throughput naps" :sparkles:
Sam: Bailey has better uptime than our staging cluster rn :grimacing: :thumbsup:
Leah: haha. ok small poll — Bailey visit to office when approved? (1) quick hello at front desk (2) full desk cameo (3) virtual cameo only (react with 1/2/3)
